title: 英勇美德 Virtue of Valor
body:
On the battlefield, you are the pinnacle of bravery. You stand resolute against any foe, from a seemingly endless wave of kobolds to a mountain-shaking titan. Without valor, the other virtues lose meaning and impact. To stand against a daunting foe or to hold tight to the exacting standards of the order of cavaliers— both of these tasks require faultless valor. You stand at the forefront of a battle, taking the vanguard position to both strike at your foes and shield your allies from your enemies' most ferocious attacks. In this manner, your adherence to valor ensures that your bravery serves as a stirring example.

Valor must be tempered with wisdom. The valorous cavalier does not fight for the sake of fighting, but for the just cause. Valor turns to bloodlust when a cavalier fails to see that skill at arms is only one solution. Tales abound of valorous cavaliers who have fallen to evil. They didn't abandon their virtue, but rather lost the wisdom needed to wield it for good.

**阵营：**守序善良，善良或无阵营。虽然英勇的理想要求勇敢作战，但是它要求其信徒不攻击弱者和无辜

**1级：英勇精神 Spirit of Valor**

As an adherent of valor, you are always ready to take up the cause of justice in battle. Your blade flies from its sheath at the first sign of combat, while your superior endurance allows you to remain in the fight long after others have faltered.

**增益：**你在先攻检定上获得+4威能加值，且你的回复力值增加2点

**1级：美德随意威能 Virtue At-Will Power**

You call upon the power of your virtue to hold your enemy accountable for the injuries it seeks to inflict on your allies. Your weapon shines with radiant energy, which flashes as you strike.

**增益：**你获得⟦报复打击 Vengeful Strike⟧威能

**7级：进阶正义之盾 Improved Righteous Shield**

When you see your allies attacked, you let the divine energy of your virtue course through you so that you can deliver vengeance upon your foes once you have protected your allies from harm.

**增益：**当你使用你的⟦正义之盾 Righteous Shield⟧时，在你下一回合结束前，你同时在下一次伤害骰上获得等同于2 + 你魅力调整值的加值。23级时，此加值等同于5 + 你魅力调整值

**11级：勇武行动 Valorous Action**

**英勇圣骑兵典范之道特性**

You live to avenge the innocent. You accept that villains and monsters will rain blows upon you, but their attacks against your allies only heighten your wrath.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你同时在攻击骰上获得+2威能加值直到你下一回合结束。如果当你花费行动点时离你5格内有至少1个重伤盟友，则此加值为+4

**11级：英勇信标 Beacon of Valor**

**英勇圣骑兵典范之道特性**

As you embody the power of your virtue, you inspire your allies to fight harder. At the same time, your valorous display terrifies your foes. Frozen in place with panic, they cannot flee the coming storm of your allies' attacks.

⟦英勇信标 Beacon of Valor⟧

**12级：英勇旗帜 Banner of Valor**

**英勇圣骑兵典范之道特性**

Many battles have turned at the foot of this banner, because warriors who might otherwise have fled the battle find the willpower to carry on. Those who stand and fight under the banner's divine glow gain renewed strength and purpose.

⟦英勇旗帜 Banner of Valor⟧

**20级：英勇责任 Burden of Valor**

**英勇圣骑兵典范之道特性**

Drawing on the power of your virtue, you force an opponent to fight you. Your divine magic stirs its bravery, causing it to focus its attacks on no one but you.

⟦英勇责任 Burden of Valor⟧

**22级：共享英勇 Shared Valor**

As battle erupts, you draw on the might of your convictions, filling yourself and your allies with courage. You then all magically leap forward to face your foes.

⟦共享英勇 Shared Valor⟧

title: 幽影学派 Nethermancy School
body:
Originating from the work of renegade wizards who were exiled to the Shadowfell, nethermancy spells extract shadow magic from the environment and blend it with arcane energy. They can create impenetrable darkness, spark terror in your enemies, and form horrific monsters from shadowstuff.

**1级：幽影学徒 Nethermancy Apprentice**

**学徒级学派法师特性**

Darkness serves at your command. Your spells fog your enemies' senses with shadow.

**增益：**被你的奥术幽影攻击威能命中的生物，视离它超过2格远的敌人为拥有隐蔽直到你下一回合结束

**5级：幽影专家 Nethermancy Expert**

**专家级学派法师特性**

Shadows crawl and writhe around you, forming a shifting tapestry of grotesque shapes. These shadows mask your presence and give you an edge when facing down a foe.

**增益：**你在威吓检定和隐秘检定上获得+2加值

**10级：幽影大师 Nethermancy Master**

**大师级学派法师特性**

Darkness sustains you, granting your spells greater potency when you are in shadows.

**增益：**当你对一个生物有任何隐蔽时，你对它获得战斗优势

**11级：幽影行动 Nethermancy Action**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Your aspect changes to something monstrous, a transformation made possible through your extensive familiarity with nethermancy's secrets.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你的空间和每个邻近你的格子形成一个黑暗区域，此区域持续到你下一回合开始。此区域对除你以外的生物是完全障目

**11级：幽影遭遇威能 Nethermancy Encounter Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

The archmage Evard mastered the Shadowfell's secrets, drawing forth its rich magic and bending it to his will. His preoccupation with such dark pursuits affected him profoundly, as is evident from the spells he left for those who would follow his path.

⟦埃瓦德之扭曲黑暗术 Evard's Wrenching Darkness⟧

**12级：幽影辅助威能 Nethermancy Utility Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Evard had few friends, largely because he regarded others as inferior. Evard's all-seeing worm is but one example of how he exploited his companions.

⟦埃瓦德之全视蠕虫 Evard's All-Seeing Worm⟧

**20级：幽影每日威能 Nethermancy Daily Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Evard is best known for drawing twisted monsters infused with dark energy from the Shadowfell. Spells such as Evard's black tentacles and Evard's dreadful mist suggest what the dark wizard was after. Evard's black gate comes nearest to realizing the secrets that Evard sought, for it creates a portal to the Shadowdark's depths, where aberrant mutants mingle with shadowborn abominations. Those who pass through the gate rarely emerge intact or sane.

⟦埃瓦德之黑暗大门 Evard's Black Gate⟧

title: 元素契约 Elemental Pact
body:
Your pact is an unusual one, since you might have made it with unwilling or unaware primordial partners. Inviting elemental power into your soul affects a subtle transformation that gives you access to elemental magic's raw, destructive potential. You venture into the wider world as a champion of destruction, a force for upheaval, armed with the power of chaos.

**1级：元素契约奖励 Elemental Pact Reward**

Your primordial connections keep you supplied with elemental power that you can release through your magical attacks.

**增益：**你获得鳞甲擅长。另外，你在你的邪术师攻击威能和邪术师典范之道攻击威能的伤害骰上获得等同于你体质调整值的加值。5级时，此加值为2 + 你体质调整值；15级时，此加值为4 + 你体质调整值；25级时，此加值为6 + 你体质调整值。

9级时，你以⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤的生物也在伤害骰上获得此加值

**1级：元素契约之赐 Elemental Pact Boon**

Souls wriggling free from those slain on the battlefield excite the chaos flowing from your pact. Elemental energy rushes out and protects you from harm. The fading life force enables you to become a creature of chaos, if only for a few moments.

**增益：**你获得⟦混沌守护 Warding Chaos⟧威能

**1级：元素契约武器 Elemental Pact Weapon**

The original blade of chaos was forged from a broken piece of panoply belonging to Miska the Wolf-Spider that was lost when the fabled Wind Dukes of Aqaa defeated him. A fouled bit of steel, nearly overlooked as mere debris, it contained a fragment of the primordial's essence. Other blades of this sort have been crafted over the years, each one channeling raw, chaotic force and enabling the wielder to turn it to advantage.

A curved chopping sword with a single serrated edge, a blade of chaos is a physical manifestation of a warlock's elemental pact. Although it appears heavy and unwieldy, the blade is easily wielded in one hand. One can feel elemental power roiling in the steel, as if the weapon were alive.

The blade's bearer can call forth its wrath with two powers born in chaos. Unraveling strike breaks down a creature's natural resistances to elemental magic, and elemental wrath releases a flood of destructive energy in whatever form the wielder chooses, to blast a foe and destroy anyone else who comes too close.

混沌之刃 Blade of Chaos邪术师装备

This large, curved blade has a single serrated edge.

    **武器分类：**
    单手军用近战武器

    **武器组：**
    重刃

    **擅长加值：**
    +3

    **伤害：**
    2d4

    **武器特性：**
    高重击

⟦拆解打击 Unraveling Strike⟧

⟦元素怒火 Elemental Wrath⟧

**7级：元素契约武器惩戒 Elemental Pact Weapon Retribution**

Enemies realize their error in attacking you when you instantly blast their thoughts with a psychic scream fueled by the chaos residing in your serrated blade.

**增益：**你获得⟦元素咆哮 Elemental Roar⟧威能

**9级：召唤邪术师盟友（元素契约） Summon Warlock's Ally (Elemental)**

The archons first appeared during the Dawn War as an answer to the angelic legions making up the gods' armies. Forged in vast numbers from elemental materials, the archons had keen intellects and an abiding hatred for their immortal foes. You can call upon an archon to aid you in battle. Although the archon has little reason to aid you, the blade you bear bends it to your will, and thus the archon fights at your side.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个亚空士兵。当你使用此威能时，掷一个d4来决定你召唤的亚空士兵类型：1，气系；2，土系；3，火系；4，水系

⟦气系亚空士兵 Air Archon Grunt⟧

⟦土系亚空士兵 Earth Archon Grunt⟧

⟦火系亚空士兵 Fire Archon Grunt⟧

⟦水系亚空士兵 Water Archon Grunt⟧

**11级：魔剑士行动（元素契约） Hexblade's Action (Elemental)**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

You can draw more sustenance from your pact when you need to push past your normal limits. When you do so, elemental essence alters your form to make it more resilient and flexible.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你获得等同于你一半等级的临时生命值。直到你下一回合结束，你的近战武器攻击触及范围增加1

**11级：元素契约面貌 Elemental Pact Aspect**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Magic that originates in the Elemental Chaos can protect you from the plane's destructive energy and help you withstand the rigors of hostile environments.

**增益：**你在坚韧检定上获得+2加值。在每次长休息结束时，选择强酸，寒冰，火焰，闪电或雷鸣。你获得对此选择的伤害类型的10点抗力，直到你下一次长休息结束。21级时，此抗力值为15。

**11级：元素契约诅咒 Elemental Pact Curse**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Although your primordial benefactors might not always be aware of your service, to ensure a steady supply of magical energy you must reinforce your pact with souls harvested from the enemies you defeat. The chaotic mind curse spell unhinges an enemy's mind to make the creature into an unwitting accomplice in creating carnage.

⟦混乱精神诅咒 Chaotic Mind Curse⟧

**12级：元素契约祈祷 Elemental Pact Invocation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Chaos surges into you when you call on your distant source for assistance. Unpredictable and potentially dangerous, the primordials' boon might either protect you from magical attacks or subject to you even greater injury.

⟦元素祈祷 Elemental Invocation⟧

**16级：进阶元素契约之赐 Improved Elemental Pact Boon**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Each enemy slain feeds power to the primordials. In exchange, they take notice of you and reward your efforts with a surge of elemental energy.

**增益：**当你使用⟦混沌守护 Warding Chaos⟧时，在你下一回合结束前，你下一次近战武器攻击造成等同于你体质调整值的额外伤害。当你进行此攻击时，选择强酸，寒冰，火焰，闪电或雷鸣作为此额外伤害的类型。

**20级：元素契约变形 Elemental Pact Transformation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

The chaos flowing into you triggers a drastic transformation. You become an elemental monstrosity, a living storm of destructive energy that shifts and changes with each attack you make. Your form protects you from those same chaotic forces.

⟦元素变形 Elemental Transformation⟧

**25级：高阶召唤邪术师盟友（元素契约） Greater Summon Warlock's Ally (Elemental)**

The primordials' firstborn, the titans witnessed and aided in the world's creation. Each titan is a vast being armed with elemental power reflecting its maker's nature and temperament. Hate drives these creatures, and they rule as petty tyrants over domains populated by giants and lesser creatures. Not even you, with all your magical power, can compel these creatures to serve you, so when you summon a titan, you are calling forth a mere fragment of its essence in whatever elemental substance is at hand.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个泰坦战士。当你使用此威能时，掷一个d4来决定你召唤的泰坦战士类型：1，风暴；2，土系；3，火系；4，寒霜

⟦风暴泰坦战士 Storm Titan Warrior⟧

⟦土系泰坦战士 Earth Titan Warrior⟧

⟦火系泰坦战士 Fire Titan Warrior⟧

⟦寒霜泰坦战士 Frost Titan Warrior⟧

title: 占火学派 Pyromancy School
body:
**1级：占火学徒 Pyromancy Apprentice**

**学徒级学派法师特性**

Fire roars through your soul just as it courses through your magic. The fire you tap in to burns hotter than any source found in the world or even on the planes.

**增益：**你在奥术火焰攻击的伤害骰上获得+1加值。11级时此加值为+2，21级时次加值为+3。另外，你的攻击无视火焰抗力

**5级：占火专家 Pyromancy Expert**

**专家级学派法师特性**

Shadows crawl and writhe around you, forming a shifting tapestry of grotesque shapes. These shadows mask your presence and give you an edge when facing down a foe.

**增益：**你在唬骗检定和威吓检定上获得+2加值

**10级：占火大师 Pyromancy Master**

**大师级学派法师特性**

Your spells ignite the ground, spreading flames and consuming your enemies even if they are fortunate enough to dodge your attacks.

**增益：**当你使用不创造区域的区域或近程奥术火焰攻击威能时，此攻击的范围成为一个区域，此区域持续到你下一回合结束。在此区域内结束其回合的生物受到等同于你体质调整值的火焰伤害

**11级：占火行动 Pyromancy Action**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Your first steps along the path of pyromancy mastery required you to relinquish some control. In doing so, you learned the secrets of fire magic. Now, when you draw upon your reserves of energy and effort, you exercise precise, deadly control of your magic.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，选择一个离你10格内的敌人。本回合内下一次你以随意或遭遇火焰攻击对此敌人造成伤害时，此敌人受到如同你在所有的伤害骰子上掷出最大值的伤害。如果你造成重击，则此额外伤害也取最大值。如果你造成的伤害不需要伤害骰，则你不获得此收益

**11级：占火遭遇威能 Pyromancy Encounter Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Kelwyn's devouring fire has a sinister reputation. It calls forth a sheet of fire similar to burning hands, but those who have survived this spell's fury claim that it is a living thing—a whispering spirit that burned both body and soul. The few pyromancers willing to discuss the spell tell of a compelling voice that sometimes speaks to them, urging them to unleash the spell and wreak havoc regardless of the consequences.

⟦凯尔温之吞噬火焰术 Kelwyn's Devouring Fire⟧

**12级：占火辅助威能 Pyromancy Utility Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

If devouring fire was the first sign of Kelwyn's descent into madness, the fiery form spell he developed marked his slow transformation from a living creature to a being of pure fire. Kelwyn's fiery form shifts its caster from a mortal creature to an elemental being of fire and ash. In this form, waves of heat cascade from you to burn creatures that draw close to you. The more victims you present to it, the deadlier the fire burns.

⟦凯尔温之烈焰形态 Kelwyn's Fiery Form⟧

**20级：占火每日威能 Pyromancy Daily Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

This deadly spell is thought by some to be the (barely) controlled version of the spell which vaporized Kelwyn and ended his dynasty. Kelwyn's final devastation channels such destructive power that even the most powerful pyromancers cannot fully control it. By surrendering to the flame, you unleash vast destructive power.

⟦凯尔温之终极毁灭 Kelwyn's Final Devastation⟧

title: 支配败德 Vice of Domination
body:
The world demands order. Chaos is a cancer, undermining civilization's advance, fomenting crimes, sowing discord, and encouraging upheaval. Understanding the world's crying need, you crusade for order at any cost. When necessary, you enforce your will harshly, making examples of the disobedient.

Good and evil are methods, not ends—they can both bring stability. You might attempt to serve the greater good even if your methods can be harsh. To channel your vice, you might seek out the basest threats to stability, such as demons, marauding monsters, and other chaotically minded evildoers. Only evil blackguards give in to true tyranny, destroying the hearts and minds of subjects to make certain they obey every command.

Within a group, you push for ideas that involve imposing order on the situation most efficiently. You might have little tolerance for disorganization, even if such a state encourages freedom. You support authority, acknowledging the most effective leader of a group you're in even if that individual is not you. However, you expect a leader to handle situations competently or to step down. Dominance is earned, not claimed.

**阵营：**必须无阵营或邪恶。善良会被秩序和权威的问题困扰，而混乱则是无法接受的。

**1级：败德精神（支配） Spirit of Vice (Domination)**

You punish disobedience with overwhelming force. It might cost you battle resilience, but the reward of punishment for your enemies is compensation aplenty.

**增益：**每轮一次，当你具有临时生命值时，你能以一个自由动作在对一个目标进行攻击检定前对你自己造成等同于你魅力调整值的伤害。然后你在对此目标的伤害骰上获得等同于你受到的伤害的加值

**1级：败德随意威能（支配） Vice At-Will Power (Domination)**

You become stronger as you prove yourself better than your opponents.

**增益：**你获得⟦支配打击 Dominator's Strike⟧威能

**7级：进阶暗影护罩（支配） Improved Shroud of Shadow (Domination)**

When you draw on shadow for protection, your shroud becomes more substantial, forming a greater barrier against your enemies' attacks.

**增益：**当你使用你的⟦暗影护罩 Shroud of Shadow⟧时，你获得等同于2 + 你魅力调整值的额外临时生命值。23级时，此额外临时生命值等同于5 + 你魅力调整值

**11级：残酷黑暗卫士行动（支配） Grim Blackguard's Action (Domination)**

**残酷黑暗卫士典范之道特性**

Your dictatorial presence creates a subtle coordination among your allies, aiding your attacks.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你在攻击骰上获得等同于离你2格内盟友数量的威能加值，直到你下一回合结束

**11级：败德遭遇威能（支配） Vice Encounter Power (Domination)**

**残酷黑暗卫士典范之道特性**

Little matters as long as order prospers. You invest your imperious nature into your weapon and release necrotic energy to take what you want by force.

⟦支配证明 Proof of Domination⟧

**12级：败德辅助威能（支配） Vice Utility Power (Domination)**

**残酷黑暗卫士典范之道特性**

In raising an icon of your vice, you drive your allies to crush the weak. Your enemies know that any sign of difficulty opens the way to their punishment in the presence of your altar.

⟦支配祭坛 Altar of Domination⟧

**20级：败德每日威能（支配） Vice Daily Power (Domination)**

**残酷黑暗卫士典范之道特性**

You can awaken a killing dread in your opponent. This mortal fear magnifies apparent threats and confuses your enemy as it flails about looking for escape. If it cannot escape your presence, it is doomed to madness and possibly death.

⟦致死恐惧 Mortal Dread⟧

**22级：败德辅助威能（支配） Vice Utility Power (Domination)**

The light created by this power encourages your allies to abide while protecting you. In truth, the shadow within you feeds from your companions to satisfy your insatiable appetite for power.

⟦暗黑恩赐 Dark Grace⟧

title: 支配领域 Domination Domain
body:
关联神祇：班恩 Bane，伊拉西斯 Erathis

Many of Bane's warpriests choose the domination domain. Some clerics of Erathis also follow this path, in the belief that civilizing the world sometimes demands harsh measures. Although clerics of domination have a justifiably bad reputation, since they terrorize and ruin those that they deem enemies of their cause, not all of them are evil. An unaligned cleric who chooses this domain might seek to turn back humanoid invaders or murderous demons, reasoning that only a stern, ruthless approach can end such threats permanently. Good-aligned clerics of domination, though, are rare.

**1级：支配领域特性和威能 Domination Domain Features and Powers**

As a cleric of domination, you are an impressive and daunting figure in battle. Your commanding presence causes enemies to cower before you while inspiring fanaticism in your allies. Your healing magic grants others additional vigor to maintain the offensive.

**增益：**你在威吓上受训

另外，当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，目标同时获得5点临时生命值。此临时生命值11级时为10，21级时为15

你同时获得下列威能

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Enemies cannot stand before your towering fury.

⟦毁灭打击 Fell Strike⟧

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Your stern confidence causes enemies to hesitate and drives those who fight alongside you to take advantage of the situation.

⟦恐惧记号 Icon of Fear⟧

**领域辅助威能 Domain Utility Power**

Your mastery of fear confers on you an unnerving aspect that helps you get what you want when dealing with others.

⟦激发恐惧 Inspire Dread⟧

**领域遭遇威能 Domain Encounter Power**

You overwhelm an enemy with doubts and fears. You and your allies become daunting figures in its fogged mind.

⟦恐惧启示 Dread Revelation⟧

**1级：引导神力（支配领域） Channel Divinity (Domination)**

You can invoke resolve—at a cost. By conjuring a psychic lash, you purge fear and doubt with intense pain and fury.

⟦残酷激励 Cruel Inspiration⟧

**3级：支配领域遭遇威能 Domination Domain Encounter Power**

The domination domain deals with more than battle mastery and tactics. Overcoming your enemy requires you to break both its body and its soul. With this power, you force your enemy to the ground. If your foe tries to stand, your divine magic rouses your allies to punish its disobedience.

⟦征服打击 Conquering Blow⟧

**5级：支配领域特性 Domination Domain Features**

Your healing magic is imbued with the spirit of battle. Not only do you mend an ally's wounds, you grant the strength and speed to get back into the fight.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，目标能以一个自由动作起身或快步1格

**7级：支配领域遭遇威能 Domination Domain Encounter Power**

A conqueror might be a skilled warrior, but a lone soldier cannot hope to defeat an army. This prayer touches on that principle. You conjure a spirit of battle to distract your foe, leaving it vulnerable to your allies' attacks, and to punish enemies that dare to move away.

⟦惊骇战士 Dreadful Warrior⟧

**10级：支配领域特性 Domination Domain Features**

You battle not only to defeat your foes, but to destroy their will to fight. A subjugated enemy is worth more to you than a slain one. Whenever you overcome an enemy with your fearsome powers, nearby foes hastily withdraw.

**增益：**当你使用带有恐惧关键字的神术攻击威能重伤一个敌人，或将一个非杂兵敌人生命值降到0时，你能以一个自由动作推离每个离你2格内的敌人最多3格。对恐惧免疫的生物无视此效果

**11级：虔诚行动（支配领域） Devout Action (Domination)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

As a priest of domination, your combat abilities and magic make you the ideal leader of warriors, a battle captain in your deity's cause. Your effort inspires a similar dedication in your allies.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，离你5格内的每个盟友都能以一个自由动作起身或快步最多2格

**11级：至高祝福（支配领域） Transcendent Blessing (Domination)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Each strike you make weakens your opponent's resolve, forcing it to withdraw before your advance. You wield fear as a weapon that leaves psychic wounds.

**增益：**当你以⟦毁灭打击 Fell Strike⟧命中时，若目标结束其下一回合时邻近你，则它受到等同于你体质调整值的心灵伤害

**12级：支配领域辅助威能 Domination Domain Utility Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

This prayer causes the slightest doubt to reverberate into a shout in your opponent's mind. Attacks that force movement awaken primal terror in their targets, who, rather than stand and fight, curl up and hope the danger passes.

⟦怯懦回响 Echoes of Cowardice⟧

**13级：支配领域遭遇威能 Domination Domain Encounter Power**

With this prayer, you hammer your foe's body and mind. Thoughts of danger in close combat with you and your allies overwhelm the enemy with mental anguish.

⟦唤起恐怖 Inspire Terror⟧

**16级：支配领域特性 Domination Domain Feature**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Under your divine guidance, your allies easily recognize which enemy is your preferred target. Upon seeing you bolster an ally, such a designated foe can lose heart.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，选择爆发范围内的一个敌人。直到你下一回合结束，该敌人提供战斗优势

**17级：支配领域遭遇威能 Domination Domain Encounter Power**

With your divine authority, you order your foes to bow down before you and encourage your allies to better their tactical positions.

⟦强求顺从 Demand Obedience⟧

**20级：支配领域每日威能 Domination Domain Daily Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Though you are a warpriest of a deity of domination, you are only as effective as your allies. When they surround or can readily gather around you, the tide of battle can turn in an instant.

⟦无情袭击 Ruthless Assault⟧

**23级：支配领域遭遇威能 Domination Domain Encounter Power**

This prayer calls forth the spirits of warriors pledged to conquest but denied victory in life. They set upon your enemies, creating openings for your allies' attacks and punishing foes who attempt to flee.

⟦胜利之魂 Spirits of Victory⟧

**27级：支配领域遭遇威能 Domination Domain Encounter Power**

This mighty power freezes an enemy with fear, hurls it to the ground, and leaves it in a state of near panic. The stricken foe perceives every nearby movement as a threat, leaving massive gaps in its defenses as it shrinks away.

⟦勇气破碎 Sundered Bravery⟧

title: 追猎者血统 Stalker Bloodline
body:
The dark curse that made you a vampire took little toll on your physical form. However, in your heart and soul, you have become a beast more terrifying than any monster you had known of in mortal life. As your power has grown, you have struggled at times to keep your feral side from taking over. Although you live for the chase and the kill, your hold on your humanity helps you glimpse the mindless savagery and wickedness that awaits you if you give in.

By controlling your bestial spirit, you can learn to take advantage of your predatory nature. The monster within is your connection between the world of mortals and the world of shadow, and it makes you strong.

**11级：追猎者血统特性 Stalker Bloodline Feature**

**吸血鬼贵族典范之道特性**

Your cunning manner keeps your true nature and identity concealed from others, even as it helps you keep your foes off guard in combat.

**增益：**你在威吓检定上获得+2加值。

此外，你在你的吸血鬼和追猎者血统攻击的伤害骰上获得+2加值

**12级：追猎者血统辅助威能 Stalker Bloodline Utility Power**

**吸血鬼贵族典范之道特性**

You are the consummate hunter, and each successful strike only increases your hunger for new prey. When one foe feels your wrath, you bring forth even greater savagery against your other enemies.

⟦猎人狂怒 Hunter's Frenzy⟧

**16级：追猎者血统特性 Stalker Bloodline Feature**

**吸血鬼贵族典范之道特性**

You have fully assimilated your animalistic side, connecting you to the beasts of the earth. You are a creature of the land in addition to a creature of the night, and the sun no longer burns you.

**增益：**你在自然检定上获得+2加值。当你尝试安抚一个野兽时，此加值增加为+4

另外，日光不再对你造成光耀伤害，且当它使你虚弱时，你在对抗此效果的豁免骰上获得等同于你魅力调整值的加值

**20级：追猎者血统每日威能 Stalker Bloodline Daily Power**

**吸血鬼贵族典范之道特性**

As you nurture your predatory side, the gnawing hunger within you grows ever stronger. The power of your stalker bloodline gives you strength in battle, and lets you release its full fury in the form of a shadowy wolf whose bite can lay waste to the deadliest foes.

⟦暗狼形态 Darkwolf Form⟧
